name: The Scythe’s first purpose

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: Velinde writes that the Scythe let her communicate with the worgen and draw them into her world. She says the first pack she summoned followed her against the demons in Felwood. To her, the weapon answered a desperate need: allies for a war her dwindling companions could no longer sustain alone. This is her account of its power and purpose, not an outside chronicle of every battle. Yet it changes the meaning of the pack at Mel’Thandris. The wolf-men are no longer only an unexplained presence; Velinde’s journal says she had summoned worgen in the forest campaign.
